title: HavenLink - Connecting Families to Licensed Adoption Agencies
content:
Connecting Children to Loving Families Through Technology

HavenLink is a secure, structured platform that bridges prospective adoptive families with licensed adoption agencies. We make the adoption journey clearer, faster, and more human.

Our Mission

HavenLink was built to transform the adoption process into a secure, transparent, and family-centered experience. We believe that connecting children with loving families should be faster, clearer, and more human.

Secure & Structured Matching

A transparent, data-driven process that ensures compatibility between families and available children.

Licensed Agency Verification

Every partner agency on HavenLink is thoroughly vetted and licensed, ensuring compliance and accountability.

Family-Centered Design

Built with sensitivity to the emotional journey of adoptive families, with empathy at every step.

The Challenge

The adoption process today is often fragmented across multiple platforms, agencies, and paperwork systems. Families struggle to navigate the complexity, verify which agencies are legitimate, and communicate clearly throughout their journey. HavenLink consolidates this experience into one secure, well-structured platform—letting families focus on what matters: building their family. 87% of families report confusion when navigating adoption agencies

How It Works

Four simple steps to connect families with their perfect match 01

Home Study Service

A comprehensive assessment by a licensed social worker evaluates your home, background, finances, and readiness to adopt, ensuring a safe and supportive environment for a child. 02

Family Intake Form

Complete a secure, guided intake form to share your family profile, preferences, and support needs. 03

Agency-Managed Profiles

Verified agencies post and manage child profiles with full transparency and structured information. 04

Compatibility Matching

Our algorithm intelligently matches families with children based on preferences, needs, and fit. Start Your Adoption Journey →

Core Features

Built with adoptive families and agencies in mind

Family Intake Form

A comprehensive, guided intake capturing family profiles, preferences, and support needs securely.

Agency-Managed Child Profiles

Agencies maintain structured, detailed profiles of children with photos, backgrounds, and needs.

Compatibility Matching

Smart matching algorithm that considers family preferences and child needs for better outcomes.

Application Tracker

Real-time status updates and secure communication channel between families and agencies.

Document Vault

Secure storage and organization of documents, legal files, and important records with encryption.

Resource Library & Support Hub

Access guides, community resources, and post-adoption support tools for ongoing family success.

Built with Child Safety & Privacy First

HavenLink is designed with the highest standards of security and legal compliance

All communication flows through verified agencies to protect child safety and privacy.

Verified Agency Partners

Every partner agency is thoroughly vetted and licensed by child welfare authorities.

Secure Authentication

Multi-factor authentication and industry-standard encryption protect all user accounts and data.

Privacy-Focused Data Handling

Data minimization, anonymization, and strict compliance with FERPA, COPPA, and adoption privacy laws.

Moderated Community Spaces

Any discussion areas are actively moderated to maintain safety, respect, and appropriateness.

What's Coming Next

We're continuously expanding HavenLink to serve the adoption community better

State Foster Care System Integration

Direct API integration with state foster care databases to streamline public child welfare matching.

Caseworker Portal

Dedicated tools for caseworkers to manage cases, track progress, and support families in real-time.

Multilingual Support

Full platform localization to serve adoptive families and agencies in multiple languages and cultures.

Legal Aid Directory

Vetted directory of adoption-focused legal professionals to support families throughout their journey.

Agency Analytics Dashboard

Advanced analytics and reporting tools to help agencies understand trends and improve outcomes.

title: Home Study Service - HavenLink
content:
Home Study Service

Step 1 of Your Adoption Journey

What is a Home Study?

A home study is a comprehensive evaluation conducted by a licensed social worker to assess your family's readiness for adoption. It's one of the most important steps in the adoption process and is required by law in every state. The home study process helps ensure that your home provides a safe, stable, and supportive environment for an adopted child, and gives you confidence that you're prepared for the unique joys and challenges of adoption.

What to Expect

1

Application & Interview

You'll complete an application and have an initial conversation with your social worker to discuss your family's background, values, and goals. 2

In-Home Visit

A social worker will visit your home to assess its safety, stability, and suitability for a child. They'll review bedrooms, childproofing, and space for an adopted child. 3

Background Checks

Criminal background checks and child welfare checks will be conducted for all adults in the household to ensure child safety. 4

Adoption Training

You may be required to complete adoption education (such as PRIDE training) to prepare you for the emotional and developmental needs of adopted children. 5

Report & Approval

Your social worker will prepare a comprehensive home study report for submission to adoption agencies and courts.

Child Safety

Protects vulnerable children by ensuring they'll be placed in safe, stable homes.

Legal Requirement

Required by law in all 50 states and necessary to proceed with adoption.

Family Preparation

Helps you understand your readiness and prepares you for the adoption journey ahead.

Is Your Family Ready?

If you haven't started a home study yet, that's okay! HavenLink can help you prepare. Our Family Intake Form will help you reflect on your readiness, assess your preferences, and connect you with resources to get started. Continue to Family Intake Form →

Compatibility Matching

Step 4 of Your Adoption Journey

Finding Your Perfect Match

The HavenLink matching system uses deterministic, data-driven scoring to suggest matches between your family profile and available children. Our algorithm considers multiple factors about your family, your preferences, and each child's needs—not guesswork or artificial intelligence, but transparent logic designed to support better outcomes.

How Our Matching Works

Our matching process is built on transparency. Every match suggestion includes a detailed breakdown of the compatibility score and the factors that influenced it. We never hide the reasoning—you'll understand exactly why we suggest a particular pairing. 1

Your Family Profile

From your intake form, we understand your household, values, experience, and preferences for a child's age, needs, and background. 2

Child Profile Data

Licensed agencies provide rich, detailed information about each child: age, developmental stage, health, personality, interests, and support needs. 3

Algorithmic Scoring

Our deterministic algorithm calculates a compatibility score (0-100) by analyzing alignment on age preference, special needs openness, sibling placement, trauma readiness, and other key factors. 4

Transparent Results

We show you the match score, the scoring breakdown, and the agency responsible for the child's profile. You can then reach out to the agency to explore the match further. 5

Agency Communication

Once you've expressed interest, HavenLink facilitates communication between you and the agency. The agency manages all next steps, including visits and legal processes.

Sample Compatibility Score

Here's an example of what a match score looks like.
